subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: rewrite the whole story. 1×8=8 (a) Many climbers who took part in them lost their lives. (b) They lift some of their men and supplies in those camps. (c) Many expeditions had been led to conquer Mount Everest. (d) Only Hillary and Tenzing reached that height. (e) As the climber were going up and up, they set camps of different places. (f) The highest camp was set up at 27000 feet but the top was still 2000 feet away. (g) Some of them had to be abandoned. (h) Sir Edward Hillary from New Zealand and Tenzing Norgey from Nepal led an expedition in 1953. R Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
guide_solution: Reordering sentences (c) + (e) + (b) + (f) + (a) + (g) + (h) + (d) Section B : Writing Test
